architecture_correction.prior_assumption_phase15_16: /api/lead forwards to JFT's own custom backend
architecture_correction.corrected_finding: /api/lead is a Cloudflare Worker handler implemented directly in worker.js, which validates/sanitizes submissions and forwards them to Web3Forms (api.web3forms.com), a third-party transactional form API, gated by an env-configured WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY secret and an optional Turnstile check

header_inventory.investigation_note: an initial grep filter appeared to miss several present headers due to a display artifact; a full unfiltered fetch immediately confirmed all headers genuinely present - self-caught, not a site finding
